method: Analytic derivation only; no new spectral roots, numerical scans, or numerical certificate were produced.
assumptions: X_c and Z_c are independent with T_c=X_c+Z_c
The positive optical gap gives f_X(0+)=0, so f_T'=f_X'*f_Z without a boundary term
The conditional law pi_t is proportional to F_X(t-z) f_Z(z) on (0,t)
Existing Robin short-time and late-time asymptotics for f_X are reused

dependencies.role: spectral tilted laws and small/late-time variance asymptotics
completed f_Z score-curvature theorem for the fixed kappa=4 benchmark

results: Exact single-integral representation under the law of U_t=t-Z conditional on T_c<=t
The sufficient condition psi_X'>=0 globally is ruled out by the short-time asymptotic and late-time pole asymptotic
The origin weight w_t(u) has O(u^(3/2) exp(-d_X^2/(4u))) decay, making the weighted psi_X' integral convergent
Short-time asymptotic: h_X'(t)-h_T'(t)=9/(121 t^3)+O(t^-2)>0 for sufficiently small t, from d_X=7/22 and d_T=1/2.

Correction: the full Robin transfer determinant gives f_X(t) ~ C_X t^(-5/2) exp(-d_X^2/(4t)); hence F_X(t) ~ const*t^(-1/2) exp(-d_X^2/(4t)) and the conditional weight w_t(u)=O(u^(3/2) exp(-d_X^2/(4u))). The leading psi_X' asymptotic remains -d_X^4/(4t^5).

Corrected short-time X_c prefactor: f_X(t)~C_X t^(-5/2) exp(-d_X^2/(4t)), F_X(t)~const*t^(-1/2) exp(-d_X^2/(4t)); hence w_t(u)=O(u^(3/2) exp(-d_X^2/(4u))). The leading psi_X' asymptotic remains -d_X^4/(4t^5).
